events.title: Tupac Shakur's Tragic Loss
events.blurb: Commemorating the 30th anniversary of the influential rapper Tupac Shakur's death in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Legacy of a Legend
angles.copy: Thirty years on, the music and message of Tupac Shakur continue to resonate. His impact on hip-hop and culture is undeniable.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Marking the anniversary of rock legend Jimi Hendrix's passing, who would have been 84.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Jimi Hendrix, the man who redefined the electric guitar, left us 56 years ago today. His sound is still as electrifying as ever.

events.title: Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic 'Abbey Road' album, featuring that legendary zebra crossing cover, was released 57 years ago today in 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album Cover
angles.copy: That album cover, those songs. The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' dropped 57 years ago, and it's still pure genius.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Celebrating the 75th birthday of The Pretenders' fierce frontwoman, Chrissie Hynde.

angles.name: Rock Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! The Pretenders legend still rocking after all these years.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Happy 54th Birthday to the legendary Oasis frontman, Liam Gallagher.

angles.name: Mad for it!
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! Happy Birthday to the unmistakable voice of Oasis, Liam Gallagher. Still got it.

events.title: Imagine's Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released 51 years ago today in 1975.

angles.name: A Song For Peace
angles.copy: More than five decades on, John Lennon's 'Imagine' still inspires. What's your favourite line from this iconic track?

events.title: The iPod's Big Birthday
events.blurb: Marking 25 years since Apple released the first iPod in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: 25 Years of iPod
angles.copy: Remember your first iPod? It's 25 years since Apple dropped the original, changing music forever. How many songs did you cram on yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: Celebrating James Bond Day, marking 64 years since the release of the first Bond film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Grab your martini, it's James Bond Day! Which 007 film or theme tune gets your vote as the all-time best?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Remembering a Visionary
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're reflecting on the profound legacy of John Lennon. His music and message live on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Celebrating the 87th birthday of the legendary British comedian and actor, John Cleese.

angles.name: Comedy Legend Turns 87
angles.copy: From Python to Fawlty Towers, John Cleese has given us decades of laughter. Happy 87th Birthday to a true British icon!

events.title: The White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking 'White Album' was released 58 years ago today in 1968.

angles.name: Experimental Masterpiece
angles.copy: Dive into the eclectic sounds of The Beatles' 'White Album', released 58 years ago. What are your hidden gems from this double LP?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Marking 35 years since the passing of Queen's legendary frontman, Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80.

angles.name: A Voice Like No Other
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago, we lost a legend. Freddie Mercury's voice and stage presence remain unparalleled. Forever a champion.

events.title: Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' influential 'Rubber Soul' album was released 61 years ago today in 1965.

angles.name: A Shift in Sound
angles.copy: The Beatles took a bold new direction with 'Rubber Soul', released 61 years ago. Which track best showcases their evolving sound?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Marking 46 years since the tragic passing of John Lennon, who would have been 86.

angles.name: His Legacy Endures
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago, the world lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to inspire generations.
